gizmo.title: Ukuhlaziywa kokufundwayo
gizmo.description: Abafundi babeka amafulegi emishweni, ezigabeni noma ezithombeni ekufundwayo eziwubufakazi belebula ngalinye, noma bakhethe isiqephu esiphendula umbuzo kangcono kakhulu.

configure.title: Umbuzo
configure.description: Lokho abafundi abacelwa ukuthi bakuthole ekufundwayo.

configure.title: Umsebenzi
configure.description: Maka ubufakazi: abafundi babeka ifulegi ngalinye eduze kobufakazi balo. Khetha esisodwa: abafundi bakhetha isiqephu esisodwa esiphendula umbuzo kangcono kakhulu.

configure.title: Abafundi bakhetha
configure.description: Lokho umfundi akukhombayo ekufundwayo. Izithombe zingakhethwa njalo.

configure.title: Amafulegi
configure.description: Amalebula abekwa ngabafundi. Sebenzisa u-Maka izimpendulo kumenyu yebhulokhi ukukhetha lapho ngalinye lifanele khona.

configure.title: Okufundwayo
configure.description: Okufundwayo abasebenza kukho abafundi. Noma iyiphi i-HTML: izihloko, izigaba, uhlu nezithombe.

configure.title: Ifomethi yokumaka
configure.description: OER Schema: ifomethi yokumaka yalokhu kuhlola (isb. amaphuzu, uhlamvu, iphesenti, ukuphothula).

configure.title: Inhloso yokufunda
configure.description: OER Schema: inhloso yokufunda ehlobene nalokhu kuhlola.

configure.title: Isifundo
configure.description: OER Schema: isifundo lokhu kuhlola okuhloselwe sona.

advanced.title: Imizamo
advanced.description: Kangaki umfundi angahlola. U-0 usho ukuthi akunamkhawulo.

advanced.title: Iyagoqeka
advanced.description: Bonisa lombuzo njengomugqa ovulekayo futhi uvaleke. Ukuvula owodwa kuvala eminye imibuzo egoqekayo eduze kwawo.

advanced.title: Qala igoqiwe
advanced.description: Uma igoqeka, qala njengomugqa ovaliwe obonisa umbuzo nesimo sawo kuphela.

developer.title: Igama lemibuzo
developer.description: Igama lemibuzo elidluliselwayo ukuze lisetshenziswe ezindaweni eziqhutshwa yi-xAPI ukuhlonza le nto
